bio.text: Lane Jean of Magnolia is serving his eighth term in the Arkansas House, representing District 99, which includes portions of Miller, Lafayette and Columbia counties.
He is a past mayor of Magnolia and served on the Columbia County Quorum Court.
He graduated from Southern Arkansas University in Magnolia with a bachelor's degree in history and works in timber, real estate and cattle farming.
